stories.title: Write introductory blog post
stories.description: Create a compelling introductory blog post explaining what ${project_name} does and why it matters

stories.title: Write 3 topic-focused blog posts
stories.description: Create 3 blog posts, one for each of the top 3 topics in config.content.topics
acceptance_criteria: Each covers a different topic from config

stories.title: Write a case study
stories.description: Create a case study or success story related to ${project_name}'s use case

stories.title: Create social media content pack
stories.description: Write 5 social media posts promoting ${project_name} across different angles
acceptance_criteria: Mix of educational, promotional, and engagement posts

stories.title: Publish all blog content
stories.description: Publish all completed blog posts and case studies to configured platforms
acceptance_criteria: All blog posts published to primary platform

stories.title: Write SEO-focused content for top keywords
stories.description: Create 2 SEO-focused articles targeting high-value keywords in the ${project_name} niche
acceptance_criteria: Primary keyword in title, H2s, and first paragraph
